bullets.title: Key US macro data due next week: GDP revision, PCE, durable orders Thursday
bullets.body: The Canada Week Ahead calendar flags US GDP second revision, PCE, and durable goods orders all hitting Thursday — a concentrated macro data day that could reprice rate expectations heading into month-end.

bullets.title: Canadian financials leading 52-week highs; broad equity breadth positive
bullets.body: 21 Canadian stocks hit 52-week highs vs. 4 lows, with financials dominating (10 of 21 highs). Major banks showing strength: NA +1.4%, TD +0.9%, RBC +0.5% on the session.

bullets.title: Colombia fiscal exposed to oil: ~$2B revenue loss per $10 Brent decline
bullets.body: Brent has already fallen from ~$120 to the $70-80 range, returning to pre-conflict levels — a significant headwind for oil-linked EM sovereigns. Colombia estimates ~$2B USD in fiscal revenue lost per $10/bbl drop in Brent.

bullets.title: Southern Copper issuing $1.25B bond to fund Peru's Tía María copper project
bullets.body: SCCO plans a $1.25B USD bond issuance to finance the Tía María copper mine in Peru, signaling continued capital deployment in base metals infrastructure despite commodity price softness.

bullets.title: Semis checks incoming: AMD pre-quiet period, AVGO, MU earnings outlook — Wolfe webcast Monday
bullets.body: Wolfe Research hosts a semiconductor-focused webcast Monday June 22 at 10am ET covering end-of-quarter channel checks, AMD ahead of its quiet period, AVGO, and MU earnings setup — key read-through for the sector into next week.

bullets.title: BoC Summary of Deliberations due Wednesday — next read on rate path
bullets.body: The Bank of Canada releases its Summary of Deliberations Wednesday June 25, the next scheduled signal on the BoC's policy trajectory after recent rate decisions.
